name: Awesome Dioxus Components
description: The official source-owned Dioxus component registry.

items.name: cn
items.description: Small source-owned helper for composing Tailwind class fragments.

items.name: button
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style native button for Dioxus with typed variants and sizes.

documentation.compositionNote: Use caller-composed children for text, icons, and icon-plus-text content. `ButtonVariant` and `ButtonSize` mirror the current shadcn visual contract; native Dioxus button/global attributes and events are forwarded.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus dialog backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus management, Escape, outside dismissal, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.

items.name: select
items.description: A source-owned compositional select with keyboard navigation and typeahead.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned Select parts; applications can style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains keyboard, typeahead, and ARIA behavior.

items.name: badge
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style status/label badge for Dioxus.

items.name: card
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style card shell composition for Dioxus.

items.name: input
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style single-line text input for Dioxus.

items.name: item
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Item composition for rows of media, content, and actions.

items.name: pagination
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Pagination composition with configurable native links.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style pulsing loading placeholder for Dioxus.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style multi-line text input for Dioxus.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A source-owned slide-in Sheet for Dioxus, composing the owned Dialog primitive.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the owned dialog primitive directly (SheetTitle/SheetDescription/Sheet re-export the Dialog primitive's parts); the styled wrapper only adds the slide-in side variant and positioning.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus tooltip backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; hover/focus/Escape handling and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives. Positioning is CSS-only via data-side/data-align attributes, matching the real upstream implementation (no portal or JS positioning engine).

items.name: popover
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus popover backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus trapping, Escape, outside dismissal, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives (reusing the same use_focus_trap/FocusTrapScript internals as dialog).

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus hover card backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; hover/focus handling and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A source-owned compositional dropdown menu with roving-focus keyboard navigation.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned DropdownMenu parts unstyled, matching select's approach: DropdownMenuItem is generic, so applications style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains roving-focus keyboard and ARIA behavior.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus context menu backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; right-click/long-press detection, positioning, roving-focus keyboard navigation, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus menubar backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; coordinated multi-menu roving-focus keyboard navigation and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.

items.name: combobox
items.description: A source-owned compositional autocomplete input with a filterable popup list.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned Combobox parts unstyled, matching select's approach: ComboboxOption is generic, so applications style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains filtering, roving-focus keyboard, and ARIA behavior.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A source-owned compositional date-grid calendar with single and range selection.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade styles the month view, navigation, title, and generated date grid with semantic shadcn tokens while the owned primitive retains single/range selection, constraints, keyboard navigation, focus, and ARIA behavior. Less common month/year selector parts remain composable exports.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A source-owned compositional date and date-range picker, composing the owned calendar and popover primitives.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade composes the installed semantic Calendar and Popover façades over the owned DatePicker primitive. The primitive retains typed date/range state, constraints, keyboard focus, dismissal, and ARIA behavior.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A source-owned collapsible sidebar layout composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Unlike most registry items, upstream ships Sidebar as a styled preview component rather than an adico-primitives module; its only shared state is a plain open/closed signal from adico_primitives::use_controlled, and it composes the owned separator primitive directly. This initial pass renders one CSS-driven collapsible layout rather than upstream's document::eval-detected mobile sheet mode (that eval pattern was found non-functional while testing the Wave 3 overlay batch); a real viewport-driven mobile mode is deferred to M4/M5.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: A source-owned CSS aspect-ratio wrapper for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned AspectRatio primitive: a CSS padding-bottom ratio wrapper with no visual styling to compose, matching upstream's own unstyled behavior.

items.name: label
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Label for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned `for`/`id` association primitive. Composes with any installed form control via matching `html_for`/`id` values.

items.name: progress
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Progress bar for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned ARIA progressbar primitive. The indicator's fill width is CSS-transform-driven from the primitive's --progress-value custom property; a `None` value renders a zero-filled indeterminate bar rather than upstream's unstyled indeterminate state, since animated indeterminate styling is M4's job.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Avatar for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned image-load-state primitive: Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarFallback. AvatarImage stops rendering on error so an installed AvatarFallback (bg-muted) takes over automatically.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Checkbox for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA checkbox primitive (checked/indeterminate/unchecked), with a Lucide Check indicator. Requires the web feature since the primitive's hidden bubble input needs the browser DOM to sync indeterminate state.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A source-owned Collapsible for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned Collapsible/CollapsibleContent/CollapsibleTrigger primitive: upstream ships it unstyled, matching shadcn's own unstyled Collapsible -- layout is left to consumer composition.

items.name: switch
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Switch for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA switch primitive, composing SwitchThumb with a translate-x thumb animation driven by data-state.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Toggle for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned pressed-state ARIA button primitive, with sm/default/lg size variants matching shadcn's Toggle.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Accordion for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus collapsible-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select). Composes a Lucide ChevronDown indicator into the trigger, matching shadcn's Accordion.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Radio Group for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus radio primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select), with a CSS-only checked indicator dot.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Tabs for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus tab-list primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select), matching shadcn's Tabs.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Toggle Group for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus toggle-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select and composes the owned Toggle primitive directly), matching shadcn's Toggle Group.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A source-owned custom-scrollbar Scroll Area for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned ScrollArea primitive: pure CSS overflow/scrollbar-width styling with no visual language to compose, matching upstream's own unstyled behavior.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Alert Dialog composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus-trap handling is delegated to the same shared internals the installed Dialog uses. AlertDialogTrigger (composing the installed Button, matching DialogTrigger) is nested inside AlertDialog so the root-level Escape handler reliably receives keyboard events; Escape is handled on AlertDialogRoot itself, the same working position DialogRoot uses. Unlike Dialog, no outside-dismiss listener is installed, matching the WAI-ARIA alertdialog pattern's requirement that only an explicit action can close it.

items.name: toast
items.description: A source-owned Toast notification system for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Only the toast region's fixed viewport placement is styled by default (structural, not cosmetic); individual toast cards keep the primitive's own unstyled composition, matching this registry's existing many-parts-unstyled precedent for Select/Combobox. A full default visual style for Toast itself is M4's job.

items.name: slider
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Slider for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned pointer-drag/keyboard value primitive. Pointer-drag interaction depends on the web feature (pointer tracking is a no-op on the native default); keyboard arrow-key interaction works on every target. Desktop pointer-capture behavior is compiled but not independently verified against a real desktop WebView, a named and recorded gap.

items.name: toolbar
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Toolbar component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. Roving-focus button/separator container, similar shape to Menubar without layered popups. No document::eval or DOM measurement, SSR-safe by construction.

items.name: virtual-list
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only VirtualList component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. Pure re-export: upstream ships it unstyled, list-item content is entirely caller-composed, and the caller must give the container a bounded height (for example `style: "height: 300px; overflow-y: auto;"`) or the viewport measurement equals the full content height and nothing is virtualized. Its scroll/resize bridge uses native `onscroll`/`onmounted` element queries (no `web`/`desktop` feature gate needed, unlike other overlay primitives) after live browser testing found upstream's own `document::eval`-based bridge never registers in this Dioxus 0.7.9/0.7.10 web runtime -- see provenance. On a renderer without `onscroll`/`onmounted` support (native/server) it renders zero items rather than failing to build -- a documented, explicit target-support skip, not silent, until a proper observer-bridge primitive exists (M6 territory).

items.name: color-picker
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Color Picker component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. HSV saturation/value drag surface with keyboard arrow-key navigation and accessible per-axis range inputs (AreaThumbSaturationInput/AreaThumbValueInput). The M3 migration queue's dependency note said this item composes label/popover/slider; reading the actual upstream primitive source found it only depends on the already-owned move_interaction/pointer modules (reused unmodified from Wave 2's Slider import), not those three registry items -- a real correction recorded per the M1 lesson to verify against source, not the queue's one-line notes. Requires the `palette` crate directly (matching upstream's own public HSV color type in its props), same as any upstream consumer.

items.name: drag-and-drop-list
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Drag And Drop List component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. Pointer-drag list reordering that reuses the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select. Keyboard reordering (Enter to lift/drop, Arrow keys to move, Escape to cancel, Delete/Backspace to remove) is the always-tested accessible path. Native pointer/mouse drag-and-drop is compiled and wired but not independently browser-verified -- a named risk carried since the M3 migration queue, the same open question as Slider's unverified desktop pointer-capture behavior.

items.name: tag-group
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Tag Group component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. Grouped multi-select tag input reusing the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select; no document::eval, portal, or DOM measurement API, so it is SSR-safe by construction.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.description: A source-owned Light/Dark/System theme toggle for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the installed dropdown-menu registry item with adico_primitives::theme_mode for Light/Dark/System selection. Persists the selection (localStorage on web, a preferences file on desktop) and applies the resolved appearance's class to the document root automatically. Classified `EXISTING_SHADCN_EQUIVALENT`-adjacent -- shadcn's theming docs ship an equivalent Light/Dark/System dropdown pattern; see parity.json and design.md §7b.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only palette switcher for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA`-style per design.md §7b and excluded from shadcn parity tracking (no parity.json entry). A distilled palette picker (Slate/Blue/Violet/Emerald/Rose/Amber presets recoloring --primary/--primary-foreground and their Tailwind aliases) productizing the concept prototyped in apps/playground's advanced customization tray, which keeps its own full 28-token editor unchanged.
